summary: InMode Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on June 18, 2026, announcing its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders to be held on July 30, 2026. The filing includes a proxy statement detailing routine matters: re-election of a Class I director, re-appointment of independent auditors (Kesselman & Kesselman/PwC), and approval of 6,000 RSUs for non-executive directors. No special-situation transaction is disclosed; the filing is a standard corporate governance update. No deal terms, price, premium, or strategic event is present.
